subject: Handle recursive serverAsserts and provide more information for recursive segfaults (#12857)
reason: The change only affects crash-report/diagnostic output in src/debug.c: it labels recursive asserts/panics, avoids a duplicate printCrashReport, and prints a reduced stack trace instead of aborting on a recursive segfault. This code runs only after a crash or assertion has already happened and changes no command reply, stored data, replication/failover/resync, persistence, or memory behavior in any non-crash path. The sole observable difference is the wording and completeness of the crash log, which no installed oracle can judge — the liveness oracle treats any crash as a failure on both builds
